claims.quote: Genetic variants affecting Heterogeneous Nuclear Ribonucleoprotein U (HNRNPU) have been identified in several neurodevelopmental disorders (NDDs).

claims.object_text: widely expressed in the human brain and shows the highest postnatal expression in the cerebellum
claims.quote: HNRNPU is widely expressed in the human brain and shows the highest postnatal expression in the cerebellum.
HNRNPU deficiency leads to chromatin remodeling of A/B compartments

claims.object_text: transcriptional rewiring partly by impacting exon inclusion during mRNA processing
claims.quote: HNRNPU deficiency leads to chromatin remodeling of A/B compartments, and transcriptional rewiring, partly by impacting exon inclusion during mRNA processing.
Genomic regions affected by the chromatin restructuring and host genes of exon usage differences show a strong enrichment for genes implicated in epilepsies, intellectual disability, and autism.

claims.object_text: increased fraction of neural progenitors in the maturing neuronal population
claims.quote: HNRNPU downregulation leads to an increased fraction of neural progenitors in the maturing neuronal population.

claims.object_text: delayed commitment of neural progenitors to differentiate in cell types with hindbrain profile
claims.quote: We conclude that the HNRNPU locus is involved in delayed commitment of neural progenitors to differentiate in cell types with hindbrain profile.

claims.object_text: in vitro neural differentiation of patient-derived and isogenic neuroepithelial stem cells with a hindbrain profile
claims.quote: in vitro neural differentiation of patient-derived and isogenic neuroepithelial stem cells with a hindbrain profile
